minor_findings.summary: A few Unicode glyph forms are normalized rather than preserved exactly.
minor_findings.evidence: The original title uses em dashes and the yield and baked-custard label use fullwidth ６; the candidate uses en dashes and ASCII 6 in those positions. The culinary meaning is unchanged.
